title: Adam Silver Sounds Alarm on How Quickly Tanking Became Accepted Across the NBA - NewsBreak
text:
By Shabiha Akter ,
1 hours ago
Adam Silver (Photo By Alonzo Adams/Imagn Images) Only a few years ago, tanking was widely criticized across the NBA and viewed as undermining the integrity of competition. However, attitudes around the strategy have shifted dramatically. Tanking has become a widespread practice for draft positioning , which tests the patience of commissioner Adam Silver and league officials.
During his NBA Finals press conference, Silver revisited the issue and expressed concern about how rapidly perceptions of tanking had changed across the league.
“ Tanking is not a new issue for this league. I think what maybe surprised us all a little bit is how quickly it became acceptable behavior in this league ,” Silver said. “It used to be limited, frankly, to a small group of teams. I think I could genuinely stand up and talk about rebuilding and not say tanking, and it was practiced in a different way .”
The NBA has already taken action this season, fining two franchises over tanking-related concerns. A recent anonymous player survey further highlighted how tanking is becoming increasingly accepted. The poll found that nearly 72 percent of NBA players did not consider tanking to be a significant issue for the league.
Adam Silver Confirms NBA Europe Expansion Remains on Schedule Beyond the discussion surrounding tanking, the NBA continues to focus on its long-term growth plans. One of the league’s biggest initiatives is the launch of NBA Europe. On Wednesday, Silver confirmed it remains on track for its anticipated debut during the 2027-28 season.
“ We are very much on schedule. It is our hope and anticipation that the league will launch in the 2027-28 season in Europe. We are on track. Final bids from franchises are due at the end of the month in June. We are very excited about the ongoing opportunity, ” he said.
Adam Silver (Image Credits: Imagn) The proposed NBA Europe league might feature 16 teams. Silver also addressed speculation about adding two additional franchises. According to the commissioner, a final decision regarding potential league expansion could come before the end of the calendar year.
